description: ETYS – SSEN Transmission – Transformer Changes is a series of datasets listed in SSEN Transmission Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SSEN Transmission is a trading name of Scottish Hydro Electric Transmission plc, company number SC213461. This dataset contains information about transmission transformer changes for years 2024/25 - 2031/32. To view or download this data, please register or login. Coverage: north of Scotland (SSEN Transmission network area). The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Usage. Its keywords are Transformer, SHE. The portal shows 132 records. The portal shows 2025-09-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-ssentransmission-portal.
